Visitor returns rendered heading template as bare string; mixed-case is preserved (regression guard for issue #350)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitHeading(ctx: unknown, level: unknown, text: unknown, id: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return `## ${text} ##`;
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<h2>Important Section Title</h2><p>Body.</p>", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
